text:
### Access Activation  
**Accounts Fully Active When:**
- ✅ KYC verification complete
- ✅ AML screening passed
- ✅ Account created in all systems
- ✅ Card issued and activated (if applicable)
- ✅ Online/mobile access configured
- ✅ Customer notified  
**Timeline:** 1–7 business days
